# lsp-max Standing Model

| Rank | State | Admission meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `UNKNOWN` | Observation is incomplete or stale; no positive claim is admitted. |
| 1 | `UNSUPPORTED` | The bounded implementation does not provide the requested capability. |
| 2 | `BLOCKED` | A required dependency or gate prevents execution. |
| 3 | `BUILD_BROKEN` | Observed build execution failed. |
| 4 | `PARTIAL_ALIVE` | A bounded checkpoint has live execution evidence; the crown remains open. |
| 5 | `ALIVE` | Witness, falsifier, independent verifier, receipt verification, and replay all closed inside the declared boundary. |

## Crown rule

`ALIVE` is lawful only when all of the following are observed and bound to the same admitted input closure:

- negative falsifier (`EVIDENCE-FALSIFIER`)
- independent verifier (`EVIDENCE-INDEPENDENT-VERIFIER`)
- receipt verifier (`EVIDENCE-RECEIPT-VERIFIER`)
- deterministic replay (`EVIDENCE-REPLAY`)
- positive witness (`EVIDENCE-WITNESS`)

`PARTIAL_ALIVE` may describe one closed checkpoint. It may not be promoted into crown standing. `UNKNOWN` does not mean refusal. `UNSUPPORTED` does not mean execution failure. `BUILD_BROKEN` requires an observed build failure.
